title: Tenure Credit on Returned-Payment Fees
content:
Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts give a tenure credit on a returned-payment fee: a flat dollar amount subtracted from the fee, set by the installments paid on the contract. Installments paid are counted as the contract's scheduled-installment payments less its returned payments, both as the loan history shows them.

| Installments paid | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | long-tenure returned-payment credit: 6.00 |
| 12 to 23 | mid-tenure returned-payment credit: 3.00 |
| fewer than 12 | no credit |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

| Scheduled-installment payments | Returned payments | Installments paid | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 26 | 2 | 24 | 6.00 |
| 25 | 2 | 23 | 3.00 |
| 13 | 1 | 12 | 3.00 |
| 12 | 1 | 11 | none |

The returned payment being charged is itself one of the returned payments counted.

Hypothetical: a fee of 52.50 before credits, on a contract with 30 installments paid, comes to 46.50 after the 6.00 tenure credit.
